"''This is Joopa Base. ''Ghost'', proceed to coordinate 6782.|Rex and Wolffe|{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}}}} '''Joopa Base''' was a modified [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype)|AT-AT]] repurposed by the [[Cloning|clones]] [[Gregor]] and [[Wolffe]] to serve as their mobile headquarters. The AT-AT originally served under the command of [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]], sent to destroy [[Rex]] and the [[Ghost]] [[Spectres|Crew]] when they were reported by Wolffe. Though the clones' [[Rex's AT-TE|AT-TE]] was destroyed, the rebels commandeered this [[walker]] and destroyed the other Imperial walkers. After the [[Assault on Seelos|battle]], Rex went on to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]], while Wolffe and Gregor remained on [[Seelos]] using this walker as their new home, naming it "[[Joopa]] Base."{{Databank|joopa-base|Joopa Base}} Over time, they repurposed parts of their former [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TE]] in order to modify their new home to include a landing pad, as well as the [[walker]]'s [[Limb|legs]], ladders and walkways. The side of Joopa Base was stylized with the emblem the [[Wolfpack]]. {{Veh-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Joopa-Base-concept-art.png|thumb|250px|left|Joopa Base concept art by Jason Pichon.]] Joopa Base first appeared in "[[Relics of the Old Republic]]," the fourth episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', albeit unnamed. Later, in [[Rebels Recon]] #2.06: Inside "[[Wings of the Master]]," [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] spokesperson [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed that Gregor and Wolffe stayed behind on Seelos and made the remaining AT-AT walker their new home.{{RebelsRecon|Jdj4teY5gik|#2.06: Inside "Wings of the Master" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-wings-of-the-master}} Concept art of Joopa Base was created by [[Jason Pichon]]. The diagrams highlighted the sections of Rex's AT-TE that were repurposed for Joopa Base.{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-fools-hope-behind-the-scenes-gallery|text=A Fool's Hope Behind-the-Scenes Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}} ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Relics of the Old Republic}} {{1st}} *{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} {{1stID|Joopa Base}} ==Sources== *{{RebelsRecon|Jdj4teY5gik|#2.06: Inside "Wings of the Master" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-wings-of-the-master}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|70|Helmets}} {{Imo}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-fools-hope-episode-guide|text="A Fool's Hope" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Walkers and Ground Vehicles of the Empire and First Order}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' {{Imo}} *{{Databank|joopa-base|Joopa Base}} ===Non-canon sources=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars Awesome Vehicles]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ジューパ・ベース }} [[Category:All Terrain Armored Transports]]
